scientific_limitations: The eight-good minimality holds only within the homogeneous-good, single-exceptional-agent family; it is not universal over all delegated allocations.
The parameter is strictly positive and below one; no assertion is made for zero values or heterogeneous goods.
All verification beyond analytical proof consists of finite exact-arithmetic tests; independent validation has not been performed.
